prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: detailed colored reveal illustration for a warm hand-drawn nonogram album, not a puzzle grid. Create exactly ONE finished standalone image, landscape aspect ratio 3:2.
Subject: the real Chocolate Hills landscape of Bohol, Philippines. Repeated smooth, rounded, near-symmetrical conical grass-covered hills, chocolate-brown and tawny dry-season slopes, separated by green vegetated valleys. Preserve this distinctive repetitive conical karst morphology.
Style: polished hand-drawn 2D children's natural-history illustration, confident clean dark warm-brown contours, broad substantial colored gouache/colored-pencil areas, restrained interior contour lines and sparse small grass marks, gentle stylized shadows. Clear shaped planes and appealing natural proportions. Rich warm earthy colors and green valleys. Detailed enough to be a rewarding reveal with visible interior drawing, not a flat logo or enlarged pixel art, and NOT photorealistic, not 3D.
Scene framing: a coherent landscape vignette with an organic irregular silhouette, including enough green ground to connect the hills and preserve spatial relationships; the open sky and ALL space outside the vignette must be genuine alpha transparency. Ground ends as a gently irregular illustrated edge, no rectangular frame or opaque background, no cut-earth diorama slab, no drop shadow, no white halo. Keep whole hill group inside image with comfortable transparent margins; no cropped edge hills.
No text, labels, numbers, watermarks, sun, clouds, people, buildings, roads, animals, ocean, palms or extraneous attractions. No mountain ridges or jagged alpine peaks, no chocolate candy. Use the details to show grass and rounded slopes, no noisy tiny flecks.
Do not add a checkerboard pattern; transparency is real PNG alpha.
Composition A: a broad panoramic view from a moderately elevated lookout. Three clearly separated large rounded cones in the foreground and midground create a readable asymmetrical rhythm, with five smaller cones staggered behind and several very small distant cones. The largest hill is slightly left of center; a green valley opens between the front cones. Layered depth is obvious but the main hill contours remain legible even as a small thumbnail. Warm soft daylight from upper left. Hills occupy most of the scene width; retain a compact 3:2 overall vignette.
